description: Plan the files for a new local Strapi plugin (`src/plugins/<name>/package.json` + a `strapi-server.js` that registers its content-types, routes, services, controllers, policies and middlewares by folder), and enable it in `config/plugins` (created if missing, an entry inserted when its export is a literal object, else a warning says what to add). Dry-run (+ `planId`, + `warnings` to verify the server entry for your Strapi version); apply with `apply_edits`. Use extract_to_plugin to scaffold AND move artifacts in one plan.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

name: create_plugin
title: Scaffold a new local plugin (dry-run)
